color.note: Light is the primary theme. Zinc neutrals carry the UI; one blue accent marks the main action, and four soft status tints carry the rest of the colour.

tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: Page background. Surfaces sit on it without borders.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, fields: one step up from bg-base. Lifted by shadow-surface in light, by tone alone in dark.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: A card nested inside a card, or a secondary card variant.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Third nesting level; table header rows.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash on pressable cards and menu rows.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs. Always paired with shadow-overlay.

tokens.name: default
tokens.usage: Neutral fill for secondary and tertiary buttons, default chips, tab tracks, icon tiles.

tokens.name: default-hover
tokens.usage: default on hover.

tokens.name: segment
tokens.usage: The selected item sliding inside a tab track or segmented control.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, body, labels. 13:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions, placeholders, meta. 5.1:1 or better on every surface, including default.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected state, focus ring, switch-on. One primary action per view.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover (darker, so on-accent keeps 5.6:1).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and accent-coloured text. 5.1:1 or better.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent (4.7:1) and on danger.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Soft accent fill: soft chips, soft buttons, selected rows, icon tiles.

tokens.name: accent-soft-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-soft (6:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Solid success fill. Text on it is on-status.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Soft success fill.

tokens.name: success-soft-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons on success-soft.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Solid warning fill. Text on it is on-status.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Soft warning fill.

tokens.name: warning-soft-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons on warning-soft.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Solid danger fill for destructive buttons. Text on it is on-accent (4.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: danger on hover.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Soft danger fill; the danger-soft button.

tokens.name: danger-soft-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons on danger-soft; inline error messages.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Text on solid success and warning fills (8:1 or better).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Outline buttons and the rare bordered element. Decorative: below 3:1, never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: 1px dividers between rows and sections inside a surface.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modal dialogs and drawers.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: the hero headline.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Ship polished screens without designing every pixel.
styles.usage: Hero subcopy and lead paragraphs, text-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Choose a date to see open times.
styles.usage: Default UI and reading text, card descriptions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, card titles, field labels, nav items.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; gap between buttons and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a card's parts; small-button padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; button padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large-card and dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on small screens.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Menu rows, keyboard keys, small thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text fields, selects, icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, nested cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, tab tracks, avatars, switches.

shadow.note: Shadows are themed: light lifts surfaces with layered micro-shadows; dark drops them and relies on tone, except overlays, which get a hairline.

tokens.name: shadow-surface
tokens.usage: Every card and text field. Replaces a border.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs: anything that floats.

tokens.name: shadow-segment
tokens.usage: The selected item in a tab track.

tokens.name: ease-fluid
tokens.usage: Overlays opening, tab indicators sliding, drawers.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Colour and background changes.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Background and colour on hover.

tokens.name: dur-press
tokens.usage: The press scale on buttons and pressable cards.

tokens.name: dur-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and the tab indicator.

tokens.name: press-scale
tokens.usage: Scale of a pressed button (0.98 small, 0.96 large) or pressable card (0.99).

tokens.name: disabled-opacity
tokens.usage: Every disabled control.
